q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance wintergloss gloss) asserts a genus the IS-A test rules out — a dried substance burned as lantern fuel is not a kind of 'gloss' — so the head genus should have been suppressed under the lexicalized-compound (hot-dog) bar.

notes: The whenever machinery is right throughout: plain-variable premises, the (sk_repel $e) per-occurrence consequent with its During link at 1.0/0.9, no QuantifierPhrase companion, the Alongside preposition-named oblique with a bare-mass constant object, 'dried' kept as a participial adjective, and Theme/Source on repel.
